## Appearance

He is a tall man, standing over six feet in height. His physique is notably strongly built.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

The Canadian harpooner is a physically powerful and vigorous individual characterized by his grave, taciturn, and often surly demeanor. Known for his impetuous and occasionally violent nature, he becomes deeply passionate when contradicted or frustrated by his circumstances. His primary motivations are a constant craving for meat and an intense, growing desire to escape his confinement in order to regain his liberty. Possessing superior skill, coolness, audacity, and cunning, he demonstrates wonderful dexterity and uncommon quickness of hand in his tasks. He is highly experienced in Arctic whaling and remains equally handy with a pickaxe as he is with a harpoon. Despite his expertise, he remains deeply displeased by the avoidance of inhabited coasts and suffers from a nostalgia that only flight can cure.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P7](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P33](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), +25 more_

## History

Ned Land, a professional harpooner of Quebecois descent, joined the crew of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a mysterious sea monster. After the vessel collided with the creature, Land and his companions were abducted and imprisoned aboard the advanced submarine, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Under the command of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), Land was forced to live in isolation beneath the sea, where he grew increasingly restless and resentful of his captivity. During various underwater excursions, he utilized his skills to hunt game and protect the group, most notably killing a shark to save an Indian diver. Despite his repeated attempts to plan an escape, Land remained trapped as the vessel traveled across the globe. His frustration peaked during a violent encounter with giant cuttlefish, where he was nearly killed before being rescued by [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). Following the Nautilus's attack on a warship, Land and his companions resolved to flee the submarine at any cost. While attempting to detach from the vessel near the coast of [Norway](../codex/places.md#norway), they were caught in the Maelstrom. The boat was torn away, and Land ultimately survived the ordeal, finding refuge in a hut on the Loffoden Isles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P9](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P15](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P16](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P18](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), +1017 more_

## Quotes

> “Well, we must accept,” said the Canadian. “But once more on dry ground, we shall know what to do. Indeed, I shall not be sorry to eat a piece of fresh venison.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P25](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0025)

> “Confound it!” exclaimed the Canadian, “I know well enough! The Nautilus has struck; and, judging by the way she lies, I do not think she will right herself as she did the first time in Torres Straits.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P3](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0003)

> “I will add,” he continued, “that, being as handy with the pickaxe as with the harpoon, if I can be useful to the Captain, he can command my services.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)

> "The Captain must be very sure of his route, for I see there pieces of coral that would do for its keel if it only touched them slightly."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P13](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0013)

> "Sir, you may believe me when I tell you that this piece of iron will navigate neither on nor under the sea again; it is only fit to be sold for its weight. I think, therefore, that the time has come to part company with Captain Nemo."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--ned-land.md)

Ned Land is a captive of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), having been taken prisoner aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) after the destruction of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). While [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) provides for his needs and has even saved him from a shark attack, the relationship is defined by Ned's lack of freedom and his growing frustration with his confinement. The tension between them stems from Ned's desire to escape the vessel and Nemo's insistence on keeping his existence a secret from the world.

- Serves under — captor  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P0](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), +4 more</sub>
- Saved — rescued from a shark attack (since v2)  <sub>[v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P48](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0048), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)</sub>

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

[Conseil](../character/conseil.md) is a close companion and fellow prisoner of Ned Land. They have shared the harrowing experience of being thrown overboard, discovering the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), and being held captive together. Throughout their time on the submarine, they rely on each other for support and maintain a bond forged by their shared predicament.

- Comrade of — fellow passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P59](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), +39 more</sub>
- Friend of — close companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), +7 more</sub>

### [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ned-land--professor-aronnax.md)

Ned Land and Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) are fellow travelers and captives who have been forced to navigate life aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) together. While they share the same status as prisoners, they often differ in perspective, with [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) frequently focused on the scientific wonders of the voyage while Ned remains preoccupied with his desire for liberty. They rely on one another to navigate their interactions with Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and the challenges of their confinement.

- Comrade of — fellow traveler and captive  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P64](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0064)</sub>
